text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- The second round of local elections was repeated on Sunday in 11 municipalities without incident. In the key town of Ohrid, the new mayor was expected to come from the ruling Socialist Party.

- The Macedonian government plans to rebuild the nation's railway system. The whole project is expected to cost 56 million Deutsche Marks. The government said the funding would come from the state budget and Macedonian Railways.

- Unofficial sources say the premier Branko Crvenkovski was preparing to reshuffle his cabinet after local elections. Portfolios tipped for replacement include Justice, Interior and Traffic ministers.
- Unofficial results from the second round of local elections in Ohrid say the leading candidate is Nikola Matievski from the Socialist Party.
